verdict.rationale: Docs confirm NVLink multi-GPU configurations (up to four/eight GPUs), HGX/NVIDIA-Certified rack-scale systems, MIG partitioning, and enterprise/datacenter deployment software stack (AI Enterprise, NIM, CUDA toolkit), and community evidence corroborates real production-scale deployment (Llama 405B on H200 SXM clusters). missing for 10: independent third-party benchmarks of full rack-scale NVLink/NVSwitch topologies and no mention of Infinity Fabric (AMD term, not applicable) or detailed multi-node scaling data.
